valuation.method: Forward Enterprise Value from 2027E Comparable EBITDA x EV/EBITDA less net debt (~C$54.5B base) divided by 1.042B common shares, converted from CAD to USD at 0.7008 CAD/USD (2026-11-13).

bear.driver: Slower project ramp, rate-settlement headwinds, or higher leverage
bear.assumption: 2027E Comparable EBITDA C$12.0B at 11.0x EV/EBITDA less C$55.0B net debt

base.driver: Execution on C$12.3B-C$12.5B 2027E Comparable EBITDA guidance and deleveraging toward 4.55x-4.6x
base.assumption: 2027E Comparable EBITDA C$12.4B at 12.5x EV/EBITDA less C$54.5B net debt

bull.driver: Stronger North American natural gas / LNG demand and under-budget project deliveries
bull.assumption: 2027E Comparable EBITDA C$12.8B at 13.5x EV/EBITDA less C$54.0B net debt

valuation.implied_by_close: At base 2027E Comparable EBITDA of C$12.4B and C$54.5B net debt, the US$64.78 close (C$92.45) implies 12.2x EV/EBITDA; published Street consensus (~US$67.66-71.45) implies ~12.5x-13.0x EV/EBITDA.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of EV/EBITDA moves the base target by US$8.34 (12.9 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: Full-year 2026 Comparable EBITDA (C$11.8B-C$12.0B guidance) and exit Adjusted Debt-to-Adjusted Comparable EBITDA (4.55x-4.6x target).

analyst_notes: Following Q3 2026 results on Nov 5, 2026 (Comparable EBITDA C$3.004B, +13% YoY; 2026 guidance raised to C$11.8B-C$12.0B), BMO Capital Markets and TD Cowen raised their CAD targets while RBC Capital and Scotiabank maintained Outperform/Buy ratings with targets of C$102-C$106 (US$71.48-74.28 at 0.7008 CAD/USD). Published Street consensus sits near US$67.66-71.45 (+4.4% to +10.3% upside), slightly above our US$67.59 base case (+4.3%), reflecting ~0.0x-0.5x higher EV/EBITDA multiple assumptions.
